scope: Synthetic symbolic scorer subprocess deadline; no inference, datasets, final outputs or regrading.

policy.limitations: OS process creation and cleanup overhead precludes a real-time scheduling guarantee; this is not a security sandbox.

coverage: Real child imports pinned math libraries and accepts synthetic fraction equivalence.
Tiny declared deadline terminates child and returns unavailable, never an incorrect score.
Empty reference and nonfinite/out-of-range deadlines reject before child launch.

remaining: Formal MATH scorer compatibility and target symbolic evaluation remain unqualified.
Existing numeric benchmark and frozen worker files remain unchanged.
